◆ About ◆
The legendary hacker from Punklorde has decided to throw down the gauntlet to Herta Space Station...

◆ Story Mode ◆
During the Starhunt Game event, complete the Companion Mission "Punklorde Mentality" in Story Mode to receive graffiti and unlock graffiti stickers.
Click on graffiti stickers to perform Light Cone analysis that grants a 4-star Light Cone "Before the Tutorial Mission Starts (Nihility)."

◆ Arcade Challenge ◆
During the Starhunt Game event, complete the Arcade Challenge to receive Always Smiling — use it in the event shop to exchange for rewards such as Superimposition materials.
"Hidden Codes" Challenge: Follow the hints to find hidden graffiti. Interact with them to receive corresponding rewards.
"Access Screening" Challenge: Follow the hints to find photo subjects. Interact with them to receive corresponding rewards.
"Sealed Sector" Challenge: During the Starhunt Game event, complete Sealed Sector on specified difficulty levels to receive extra rewards.

◆ Graffiti Mode ◆
During the Starhunt Game event, you can switch to Graffiti Mode when using the Camera. Get creative and spray your own graffiti! Selecting "Start graffiti!" in Story Mode is another way to access Graffiti Mode.
Trailblazers can mix and match graffiti to create fun combos. You can redo or erase part of your work to make room for something new. Please note that the oldest graffiti will be replaced when more than 8 graffiti have been laid down in the same area. Graffiti will disappear when you leave the current area.

◆ Event Tips ◆
After the limited-time event "Starhunt Game" ends, Trailblazers can no longer claim event rewards. However, you can still play the Companion Mission "Punklorde Mentality" and the "Sealed Sector" challenge.
